ui.summary: Implemented the ui half of PRD_VIEWER_CLARITY. The changes are in src/projects and tests/project-workflows only, and nothing was committed. What was built: (1) Executor marks. EXECUTOR_LABEL, executorCategory and executorOf are in status.ts. Every graph node gets the class is-agent or is-controller, a dashed stroke-dasharray attribute for the verifier and controller, the executor in its meta line and aria-label, and there is a three-entry graph-legend. NodeDetail has an 'Executed by' fact, and a review node says 'one print job per reviewer' when the served review's transport is print. (2) NodeDetail is split into ProducedEvidence (launch node: result facts and created files, then completion, launch receipt and the task in a closed <details data-testid=task-details>) and VerifiedEvidence (verify node and candidate lanes: result facts, a gate section with deferred checks and ownership, checks with logs, screenshots, and other artifacts other than file artifacts). The candidate lanes link to the launch node's files. (3) New CreatedFiles.tsx renders 'Files created or changed': Markdown inline through src/document/Markdown.tsx, other text as source on demand, files_not_captured with their reasons, and a legacy message when nothing was captured. (4) findingsForFile and linesNamed are in findings.ts. Each captured file lists the findings that name it, with a 'show lines' control that switches to the source, sets data-finding-line on the lines and scrolls to them. Review findings that name a captured file link to its panel on the launch node. (5) ReviewDetail has a 'reviewer' grouping: declared order, labels with id, verdict and severity counts, a hidden guard group, reviewer as the default when there are several reviewers, and the reviewer filter works with every grouping. (6) New scroll.ts keepInView keeps a handed-over target in view while content above it loads. (7) Fixtures and seeds have a new clarity-flow workflow with run run-files-captured (file artifacts for a .md and a .ts, too_large and binary entries, findings with and without line ranges plus one similar path). Existing runs are unchanged. (8) New clarity.spec.ts has one test per scenario id. finding-to-task is extended for the disclosure. worker-inputs, inputs-paths-redacted, viewer-three-lanes, legacy-run, run-evidence and viewer-two-reviewers were changed where the PRD moves things: the task is now collapsed, checks moved to the verify node, and several reviewers now open grouped by reviewer. CHECKS RUN IN THIS WORKTREE: npm run build FAILED (exit 1, 24 TS errors). All come from the file kind missing in contracts/workflow/v1.ts, e.g. "src/projects/NodeDetail.tsx(150,88): error TS2367: ... '\"log\" | \"other\" | \"patch\" | \"test_report\"' and '\"file\"' have no overlap" and "src/projects/files.ts(14,56): error TS2339: Property 'files_not_captured' does not exist". npm run test:unit PASSED (130/130). The project-workflows browser suite FAILED in both phases (worker and candidate, exit 1) before any test ran. fixtures.ts validates the new result at import and gets ZodError invalid_value: 'Invalid option: expected one of "patch"|"log"|"screenshot"|"test_report"|"other"'. SUPPLEMENTARY CHECK, not a gate: a scratch copy outside the worktree was set up with a local shim of the PRD 4.1 contract. The shim adds the file kind with path, adds files_not_captured, and makes the server pass files_not_captured through and serve file artifacts as text/plain. There, tsc -b and eslint passed, and the browser suite passed 26/26 in both the worker and candidate phases, including all six new scenarios and every existing one. One earlier worker-phase run in the scratch copy had a transient 'Page crashed' in empty-states, which passed on rerun. The combined candidate with the adapter's real schema was not run here.
open_assumptions: A finding names a file only as a whole path: the characters around it must not be part of a path, so docs/a.md does not match src/docs/a.md or docs/a.mdx. A trailing period or a :N / :N-M suffix still counts. An en dash is also accepted in ranges.

The type code assumes the adapter's schema gives artifacts an optional path and kind 'file', and gives results an optional files_not_captured of {path, reason} with the four reasons, as pinned in PRD 4.1. A differently shaped type would need small adjustments in files.ts.

The served result has no ownership field. The verify view's 'ownership outcome' is derived: worker phase means ownership was enforced, and passed or not follows the gate status and error. Candidate lanes say ownership is enforced per lane, not at the candidate.
Required-check links in the task now go to the verify_<lane> node, because the launch node no longer has a checks table. The link carries data-check-index but does not scroll to the check.
A captured file whose path is not in changed_files is still listed. A changed file in a capture-era result with neither an artifact nor a reason says 'not captured, and no reason was recorded'.

The graph meta line uses short words (agent, verifier, controller) and is squeezed to the node width with textLength when it is long. The legend and item layout use inline styles, because stylesheets were out of scope.
Reviewer groups with no visible findings are hidden, like every other grouping, so a reviewer with no findings, or one filtered out, has no group.
Existing specs were updated for the behaviour the PRD changes: the collapsed task, checks moved off the launch node, and reviewer as the default grouping.

adapter.summary: Implemented the adapter half of PRD_VIEWER_CLARITY. Capture: workflow/checks.py verify_revision, worker phase only, after the clean-worktree check and before setup/run_lane_commands, copies each changed regular text file (UTF-8, no NUL) as a `file` artifact with repo-relative `path`; other paths go to files_not_captured with binary/too_large/missing/budget; caps FILE_CAPTURE_LIMIT=512 KiB and PACKET_FILE_CAPTURE_LIMIT=8 MiB; candidate phase captures and lists nothing. recheck_packet verifies file artifacts by sha256 like every artifact (existing evaluate_worker loop); verification.py also rejects file/uncaptured paths that are not distinct changed files. Contract: contracts/workflow/v1.ts artifact kind gains `file`, optional `path` (relativePath) required exactly when kind is file (zod refine + exported JSON Schema anyOf), optional files_not_captured; contract_version stays 1.0.0; schemas regenerated; validateWorkerResult cross-field rule; READMEs, examples.ts and contract.test.ts updated in both families (projects examples gain servedWorkerResult). Server: server/projects.ts registers `file` artifacts, serves them as text/plain; charset=utf-8 inline, passes files_not_captured through. Tests: new workflow/test_checks.py (capture-text-files, capture-before-checks, tampered-file-artifact, caps/text rule, budget, symlink, schema path rule, cross-field); server/projects.test.ts served-files plus a malformed-files test. Docs: workflow/RUNBOOK.md, workflow/CHEATSHEET.md, features/project-workflows/README.md. Checks run in this worktree (after npm ci): workflow unit suite 204 tests OK (final run; two earlier full runs each had one different test_automatic failure under machine load, the affected classes and the whole test_automatic module (94 tests) then passed alone); npm run test:contracts 20/20 pass; npm run test:unit 130/130 pass; npx tsx --test server/projects.test.ts 37/37 pass (not part of test:unit); npm run build exit 0. No commit, push or merge.
open_assumptions: Artifact shape: a single object with kind enum incl. `file` and optional `path` (TS type `path?: string`), enforced by zod refine and a JSON Schema `anyOf` rather than a discriminated union, because a union broke the ui lane's tests/project-workflows/fixtures.ts type-check (npm run build). A non-file artifact carrying `path` is invalid.

Regenerating schemas also changed contracts/workflow/event.schema.json and contracts/projects/reviewResult.schema.json (both embed artifactSchema): additive, no version bump; the review diff must still be a `patch`.
`missing` also covers changed paths that are not regular files inside the worktree (symbolic links, never followed; submodules), in addition to deleted or renamed-away paths.
`budget`: a file that would take the packet's captured total past 8 MiB is listed as budget; later smaller files that still fit are captured (changed-file order).
Worker-phase results always carry files_not_captured (possibly empty); candidate-phase and pre-capture results omit it. The served result omits it when the packet lacks it.

Added cross-field rules (TS validateWorkerResult and Python evaluate_worker): every file-artifact path and files_not_captured path must be a distinct entry of changed_files; a violating packet is blocked / served as RESULT_INVALID.
server/projects.test.ts is not in `npm run test:unit`; it was run directly with tsx.
Ran `npm ci` in the worktree to install node_modules (gitignored; no manifest changes).
